verdict.rationale: Cekura has a dedicated first-party guide for setting up and managing automated cron jobs for agent testing and evaluation workflows, which directly covers scheduling recurring jobs. GitHub Actions CI/CD offers a further way to automate test runs, though it runs on code changes rather than on a schedule. missing for 10: details on schedule configuration and options, evidence that cron jobs can be created or managed through the API, CLI, or MCP for AI-native use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
